chunks: From him, from Ali, from Bakkar, from Ali bin Qadim, from Fatar, from Asim, from Zarr bin Habish, from Abdullah bin Masud, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: If only a single day remained from the tenure of the world, Allah, the Mighty and the High, would prolong that day until He sends a man from my progeny whose name matches my name and whose father's name matches my father's name; he will fill the earth with justice, just as it had been filled with oppression.

key_terms.يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ عَدْلًا: He will fill the earth with justice

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about the prolonging of a single day for the appearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith underscores the divine guarantee of the Mahdi’s appearance by extending time itself, emphasizing the cosmic significance of his mission. It highlights the concept of *Ithbat al-Nafs* (confirmation of the self), where the Mahdi shares the Prophet’s name and father’s name, and fulfills the eschatological promise of global justice (*Adl*) to counterbalance widespread tyranny (*Jawr*).
